st-qa-bitcoin-se-015.text: An ASIC miner is an application-specific integrated circuit designed for Bitcoin mining, which is thousands of times more efficient at the specific task of mining compared to a regular computer [1]. It beats a regular computer because it is built for the specific task of mining (making it thousands of times more efficient) and miners rely on centralized mining pools that control 50% of the network's processing power, whereas ASICs dominate the mining ecosystem. [1]
